content: Sɑlomɔɔn mɔnnu. Bii bwisiɡiiwɑ u rɑ de win tundon nukurɑ n do. Adɑmɑ bii ɡɑri bɔkɔ u rɑ win mɛron nukuru sɑnkuwɑ.
Dukiɑ ye bɑ wɑ kɑ kɔ̃sɑn swɑɑ, yɑ ku rɑ ɑrufɑɑni ɡɑɑ ko, ɑdɑmɑ ye bɑ wɑ dee dee, yerɑ yɑ rɑ wɑ̃ɑru wɛ̃.
Yinni Gusunɔ kun ɡemɡii derimɔ ɡɔ̃ɔru sɔɔ, ɑdɑmɑ u rɑ tɔn kɔ̃so birewɑ ye u binɛ sɑ̃ɑ.
Wi u yikuru mɔ, wiyɑ sɑ̃ɑrɑ rɑ deemɛ, ɑdɑmɑ wi u hɑniɑ mɔ, wiyɑ u rɑ dukiɑ wɑ.
Wi u dĩɑnu mɛnnɑmɔ ɡɛ̃ɛbun sɑɑ, u lɑɑkɑri mɔwɑ, ɑdɑmɑ wi u dò sɑɑ ye, u koo sekuru wɑ.
Gemɡii u rɑ tii domɑru kɑsuewɑ, ɑdɑmɑ tɔn kɔ̃son nɔɔ ɡɑ rɑ n kɔ̃sɑ bɛkiwɑ.
Bɑ ku rɑ ɡemɡii duɑri, ɑdɑmɑ tɔn kɔ̃so, bɑ rɑ nùn duɑriwɑ sere kɑ win yĩsirɔ.
Wi u bwisi mɔ, wiyɑ u rɑ sɔ̃ɔsiru wure, ɑdɑmɑ wi u kun ɡɑri ɡerubu yɛ̃, u rɑ kɑm kowɑ.
Wi u sĩimɔ ɡem sɔɔ, u ku rɑ n nɑnde, ɑdɑmɑ wìn sɑnu sɑnusu kun dɛɛre, u koo sɔ̃ɔsirɑ.
Wi u win beruse ɡɔni, u nùn nuki sɑnkumɔwɑ, ɑdɑmɑ wi u kun ɡɑri ɡerubu yɛ̃, u rɑ kɑm kowɑ.
Bwisiɡiin ɡɑri yi sɑ̃ɑwɑ wɑ̃ɑrun nuuru, ɑdɑmɑ tɔn kɔ̃son ɡɑri, kɔ̃sɑ yi rɑ n bɛki.
Tusiru tɑ rɑ sɑnnɔ seeyewɑ, ɑdɑmɑ kĩru tɑ rɑ torɑnu kpuro wukiriwɑ.
Lɑɑkɑriɡiin ɡeren diyɑ bɑ rɑ bwisi wɑ, ɑdɑmɑ bokurɑ tɑ rɑ n ɡɑri bɔkɔ mɑrɑ.
Bwisiɡii u rɑ bwisi berewɑ nɡe ɑrumɑni, ɑdɑmɑ ɡɑri bɔkɔn ɡere yɑ rɑ de u biru wurɑwɑ.
Gobiɡiin ɑrumɑni yɑ rɑ nùn kɔ̃suwɑ nɡe ɡbɑ̃rɑru, ɑdɑmɑ sɑ̃ɑron sɑ̃ɑru tɑ rɑ nùn kɑm kowɑ.
Gemɡiin sɔmburu tɑ rɑ dewɑ u n wɑ̃ɑ, ɑdɑmɑ tɔn kɔ̃so u rɑ win dukiɑ dendiwɑ u kɑ kɔ̃sɑ ko.
Wi u rɑ kirɔbɑ yɑɑye u koo wuswɑɑ dɑ win wɑ̃ɑru sɔɔ, ɑdɑmɑ wi u rɑ ye duɑri u ko n kɔ̃ɔrɑmɔwɑ u n dɔɔ.
Wi u tusiru beruɑ ɡɔ̃ruɔ u sɑ̃ɑwɑ murɑfiti. Mɛyɑ wi u mɑɑ seedɑ weesuɡiɑ dimɔ u sɑ̃ɑwɑ ɡɑri bɔkɔ.
Gɑri bɛkɛɡii kun torɑnu kpeemɔ, ɑdɑmɑ wi u rɑ win yɑrɑ nɛnɛ u sɑ̃ɑwɑ bwisiɡii.
Gemɡiin ɡɑri yi sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe sii ɡeesun tii, ɑdɑmɑ tɔn kɔ̃son bwisikunu nu ǹ ɑrufɑɑni ɡɑɑ mɔ.
Gemɡiin ɡɑri yi rɑ kɑ tɔn dɑbinu ɑrufɑɑni nɑɑwɛ, ɑdɑmɑ ɡɑri bɑkɑsu su rɑ ɡbiwɑ sɛkum lɑɑkɑri sɑrirun sɔ̃.
Yinni Gusunɔn domɑrɑ tɑ rɑ tɔnu ko dukiɑɡii. Tɔnun tiin himbɑ kun ɡɑ̃ɑnu sosimɔ wi sɔɔ.
Gɑri bɔkɔn mi, kɔ̃sɑn kobu bu sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe dweebu. Nɡe mɛyɑ lɑɑkɑri yɑ mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ bwisiɡiin mi.
Yèn bɛrum kɔ̃sɑn kowobu bɑ mɔ, yerɑ yɑ rɑ bu deemɛ. Ye mɑɑ ɡemɡibɑ kĩ, yerɑ n dɑ koore.
Wɑhɑlɑ yɑ̀ n seewɑ nɡe woo ɡunɑ, yɑ rɑ tɔn kɔ̃so surewɑ, ɑdɑmɑ ɡemɡii u rɑ n yɔ̃wɑ dim dim sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ.
Tɑm mɔmmɔm mu rɑ donnu sirewɑ, kpɑ wiisu su nɔni sɔkiri. Nɡe mɛyɑ yikuro u rɑ win yinnin mɔru seeye.
Be bɑ rɑ Yinni Gusunɔ nɑsie, berɑ bɑ rɑ tɛ, ɑdɑmɑ durumɡibu bɑ rɑ ɡbiwɑ sɛkum.
Gemɡiin yĩiyɔbu bu rɑ nùn nuku dobu wɛ̃wɑ, ɑdɑmɑ tɔn kɔ̃soɡibu kun ɑrufɑɑni ɡɑɑ mɔ.
Yinni Gusunɔ u rɑ ɡemɡibu kɔ̃suwɑ, bɑ̀ n sĩimɔ win swɛɛ sɔɔ, ɑdɑmɑ u rɑ tɔn kɔ̃sobu kɑm koosiewɑ.
Gɑ̃ɑnu ɡɑnu sɑri ni nu koo ɡemɡii surɑ, ɑdɑmɑ tɔn kɔ̃so u ǹ kpɛ̃ u sinɑ tem mɛ sɔɔ.
Gɑri bwisiɡiiyɑ yi rɑ yɑri ɡemɡiin nɔɔn di, ɑdɑmɑ bɑ koo wee kowon yɑrɑ burɑwɑ.
Gemɡii, durom ɡɑriyɑ u rɑ ɡere, ɑdɑmɑ kɔ̃sɑ tɔn kɔ̃son nɔɔ ɡɑ rɑ ɡere.
